purpose: Separate failure of the MM estimator on gross outliers from failure of PSO search.

dataset.provenance: PMF-style reconstruction; not the original PMF D5/D6 point clouds

selection_rationale: A deterministic two-cluster split of log 16-NN distances retains the cluster with the smaller median distance. It does not require a contamination ratio or labels. Ground-truth labels are used only for post-hoc selection-quality analysis.
revision_history: A non-formal pilot with seed 20260901 used a fixed 20% support. It recovered radius but truncated height/span (Chamfer 0.52088, F-score 0.80826), showing that a fixed fraction discarded too many inliers at 50% contamination. No formal seed is reused from that pilot.

evaluation.success_definition: Same fixed Chamfer and F-score thresholds as the main experiment

reporting.interpretation: Any gain belongs to robust support preprocessing, not to PSO itself.
